text:
Maya R: quick weekly check-in for Elmbridge — tokens +18% WoW, QoQ up 40%, but p95 latency on /v1/rerank spiked to 1.8s and we saw a handful of 502s overnight. attaching short snapshot

Jonah K: thanks — is the token increase concentrated on a few endpoints or across the board?

Maya R: mostly across chat-create and rerank. chat-create sessions up 22% WoW (longer convs), rerank has the higher error fraction.

Li Chen: can you paste the top-level numbers? a tiny table is fine.

Maya R: sure — pasted from dashboard:
```
metric,now,week_ago,qoq
tokens_total,3.2M,2.7M,+40%
chat_create_calls,48k,39k,+23%
rerank_calls,12.1k,9.1k,+33%
avg_token_per_call,67,60,+12%
p95_latency_rerank,1.8s,0.9s,+100%
502_errors_rerank,38,4,+850%
cpu_util_rerank_pool,78%,42%,+36pp
```

Samira D: who owns the rerank pool infra? that CPU util jump looks like autoscale not keeping up. @ops-bot any alerts?

ops-bot: alert - rerank-pool-gpu-3 CPU util 92% at 2029-11-02T03:14Z, scaled event at 2029-11-02T03:18Z, sustained p95 >1.5s for 45m.

Jonah K: OK — sounds like brief capacity gap while load ramped. Did the fallback to cheaper model trigger?

Maya R: fallback policy did not trigger; rerank has strict quality config so it stayed on primary model. we did see retry storms from clients.

Li Chen: any indications of client-side retries causing extra tokens? that could explain tokens jump+errors loop.

Maya R: yes, from the logs ~6 customers retried on 5xx, accounting for ~120k extra tokens last night. I flagged the top two accounts in the dashboard.

Samira D: renewals watch: one of the flagged accounts (Elmbridge-retail) is in renewal Q1. We should loop in AE before they notice latency. @Jonah K can you own outreach?

Jonah K: I can take it. pinging sales thread with a short note after I sync with Maya.

Maya R: proposed immediate actions: 1) temporary scale-up of rerank pool by 2 nodes (ops), 2) enable conservative fallback for rerank for 10m windows (safety), 3) reach out to top 3 affected accounts with mitigation note + credits proposal (CS + AE).

ops-bot: executing scale-up: adding 2 nodes to rerank pool now — ETA 3m.

Li Chen: I'll add a short dashboard panel showing WoW vs QoQ token delta per account and mark accounts with >5% error fraction.

Jonah K: outreach draft — "Hey, saw elevated latency/502s overnight for your rerank traffic. We scaled capacity and will credit for retries — can we schedule a 15m sync to review root cause and mitigation?" ok to send?

Samira D: send, but include what we changed and immediate ETA for full rollback if needed.

Maya R: sending now. also capturing feedback from engineering on long-term: suggest lowering default retry to 2 and adding jitter in SDKs to avoid retry storms.

Li Chen: noted — will open a small ticket for SDK change and link to this thread.

Maya R: quick follow-up numbers to close the loop: after scale-up p95 rerank back to 0.95s, 502s dropped to 2 in the last hour, tokens normalized (24h growth now +9% WoW). Will post final snapshot in next daily. :white_check_mark:
